source_text: Evidence-based policies should thus differentiate contexts: promote adult voluntary circumcision in high-risk epidemics per WHO data, but in low-prevalence regions, default to preservation with parental opt-in only after disclosing absolute risks (e.g., 1 in 500 severe complications) versus benefits, avoiding public funding for non-therapeutic procedures to align incentives with empirical net gains. [103]
